prompt: I created a pull request for feature #10 for main. It shouldve been to dev instead. Please fix that for me.
summary: Found PR #55 (feature/10-functional-non-functional-goals) had already been merged into main instead of dev, leaving dev missing the goal-catalogue commits. Asked the user how to correct it via AskUserQuestion; user chose cherry-picking over a dev merge. Cherry-picked the three commits (7566a93, efc2731, 236bc76) onto dev without rewriting main's already-pushed history, verified the resulting file matches main byte-for-byte, and recorded this as a third branching-policy deviation in notes/02-project-management.md and project-journal.md, alongside the first two.

prompt: Based on our other documentation, think of possible risks and add them to this list. Append the list how you seem fit / how it is best practice for companies.
summary: Rewrote 00-Meta/Project-Management/03-Risk-Analysis.md's Risk Ratings table from a bare 3-row Likelihood/Impact/Priority table into a company-style risk register: added Category and Mitigation/Response columns, backfilled them for the three existing risks (Multiplayer, Complexity, Sickness), and added 13 new risks mined from project-journal.md, sprint-log.md, 01-Github-Project.md and CLAUDE.md (schedule contradiction, missing velocity/burn-down data, undecided multiplayer tech and resource/energy scope, underspecified rulebook, coverage/documentation discipline, role concentration, external-playtester dependency, unstable board-parsing route, dependency-approval bottleneck, public-repo academic-integrity exposure, presentation hardware-failure fallback). Added a one-line Priority legend under the matrix.
